name: Aven Home Equity Visa Card

apr.notes: Variable APR based on the Prime Rate plus a margin; the card is a line of credit secured by home equity, so no single published range applies. 2.5% fee on balance transfers and cash outs.

credit_required.notes: Homeowners only; the credit line is secured by home equity, with limits up to $400,000.

base_rate.description: 2 points per $1 (2% cash back) with AutoPay on; 1.5 points per $1 with AutoPay off.

notes: Serviced by Aven. A home equity line of credit accessed by Visa card. No Visa network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
